title: Expressive range / Dialed up

location.series: Elvis Dinh / Instagram brand design system / project year 2022

slide_intent: Increase expressive variety when the occasion needs a distinct cultural voice.
strategic_value: An expanded range can let Instagram celebrate different communities while retaining familiar marks.
demonstration: A collage combines an emotional photo message, a bright illustrated Spanish-language panel, a skate image and a Pride composition.
practical_value: Choose additional colors and treatments because of the cultural moment rather than treating expansion as the default.

content_islands.name: Large upper example
content_islands.spec: Give the soft-focus photographic message the largest area.

content_islands.name: Cultural examples
content_islands.spec: Arrange the illustration, skate-day and Pride examples beneath it.

reference_purposes.Intent: The adjacent text says dialing up celebrates cultural and special moments.
reference_purposes.Expression: The examples introduce more varied colors, illustration and headline treatments.
reference_purposes.Application: The collection demonstrates the expressive mode across cultural topics.

ingredient.name: Expanded color mode
ingredient.role: Give special moments a wider expressive range.
ingredient.application: Introduce more of the extended colors, as the source describes.
ingredient.scope: The dialed-up mode for cultural or special moments; it does not replace the core starting point.
